title: Evening Sunwatch
text:
🌇 Evening Sunwatch — November 25, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B1.5)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B5.0 (Peaked November 25, 2026 at 20:24 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 347 km/s (Calm)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 1.00)
🚨 NOAA Watch: Geomagnetic Storm Category G1 Predicted

Looks pretty quiet right now. 🤍

A prominent coronal-hole region is visible on the solar disk, while substantial sunspots remain minimal.

Image: NASA SDO — AIA 171 Å + HMI Magnetic Polarity
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
